content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I have three analog inputs (0-10V) and one analog output (0-10V). The analog output should always reflect the highest value from among the analog inputs. For example, if the inputs are 3V, 8V, and 6V, the output should be 8V. Can anyone advise on how to achieve this?
